html:
Top spiritual tourist destinations in Vietnam, please refer to before traveling Vietnam, to have the most enjoyable trip, especially those who are looking for spiritual tourist destinations that not only help connect with the gods but also help people find peace in their souls.

On a pilgrimage trip, you will find the sacred, which will bring you many wonderful experiences. You will discover many things after each pilgrimage. Go on a pilgrimage today to find serenity to dispel the hustle and bustle of daily work. Below are the best destinations that Vietlook Travel wants to introduce to you!

Top 8 most sacred pagodas in Vietnam, please refer to before setting foot here, visit and pray, and wish for health and peace, please refer to them.

Perfume Pagoda

As one of the top spiritual destinations in Vietnam, it attracts many Buddhists and tourists to burn incense and pray for health and peace. Every year, during the Perfume Pagoda festival (January of the lunar calendar), thousands of people from all over the world come here to worship at the pagoda, including foreign tourists who travel to Vietnam. They come to the pagoda to burn incense and pray and join in the atmosphere of the pagoda festival.

If you are planning to go on a pilgrimage, join Vietook Travel to Perfume Pagoda, you will immerse yourself in a peaceful, quiet space and feel the spiritual power of people with the same faith and belief.

Perfume Pagoda is considered a spiritual paradise with pristine beauty, fresh nature and unique architecture, surrounded by limestone mountains, waterfalls, caves and green forests or clear streams. You will enjoy the quiet spiritual space and feel the serenity and peace in this spiritual space.

In addition, you can participate in Buddhist ceremonies, pray, perform rituals and burn incense, or you can also find a quiet corner to meditate, focus on your inner self, and pray for health, happiness and peace for your loved ones and family.

A trip to Huong Pagoda will help you find empathy and connection with the Buddhist community, helping you reduce stress and anxiety while seeking peace and direction for the future.

Yen Tu Pagoda

A famous spiritual place in Vietnam, attracting many tourists to pray for peace of mind. A pilgrimage to Yen Tu Pagoda will bring you a sense of serenity, peace and a brighter soul.

Coming to the pagoda, you can participate in spiritual activities such as worshiping Buddha, praying, releasing statues and burning incense.

Especially when conquering the top of Yen Tu mountain, it will be a memorable experience, you will see the beautiful and peaceful panorama.

Yen Tu Pagoda has a special history and spirituality in Buddhist beliefs. This is where King Tran Nhan Tong practiced and founded Yen Tu Zen sect, one of the largest Zen sects of Dai Viet during the Tran Dynasty.

In addition, Yen Tu Pagoda also has unique architectural works such as: Kinh Thien Bridge, Bao Linh Pagoda, Dai Bi Palace, Tran Nhan Tong Temple, … All create a sacred and solemn space, helping you feel the peace and tranquility in your soul.

It can be said that on a pilgrimage to Yen Tu Pagoda, you will feel the unique and distinctive features of spiritual beliefs in Vietnam. You will find peace in your soul and feel the power of faith and Buddhism.

Bai Dinh Pagoda

As one of the famous spiritual tourist destinations in Vietnam, attracting thousands of Buddhists and tourists to visit, pray and seek peace of mind. Bai Dinh Pagoda is a large spiritual architectural work in the North.

Every year, the pagoda holds many traditional Buddhist prayer sessions to pray for blessings and peace. If you are planning to go on a pilgrimage, Bai Dinh Pagoda is a destination for you, especially for tourists who travel Ninh Binh for the first time in the spring, they all visit Bai Dinh Pagoda to visit and offer incense to pray to feel the feeling of lightness and serenity. Besides performing the pagoda’s prayer rituals, you can also explore the unique architectural works and the most notable highlight of Bai Dinh Pagoda – the giant Amitabha Buddha statue 10 meters high and weighing up to 60 tons.

This is one of the largest Buddha statues in Vietnam and is considered a unique sculpture by Vietnamese artisans.

Besides the Amitabha Buddha statue, Bai Dinh Pagoda also has many other beautiful and unique sculptures such as: Tam Thap statue, Buddha statue, Bai Dinh Pagoda gate, …

Ba Vang Pagoda is known as an ancient pagoda, where many Buddhists come to pray. Especially on traditional holidays, the first or middle of the lunar month, or Buddhist prayer chanting sessions are often held at the pagoda.

Ba Vang Pagoda

The pagoda has many spiritual festivals, Ba Vang Pagoda also has unique architecture. The pagoda is located in a primeval forest with waterfalls, lakes and green hills all year round, a peaceful scene.

The pagoda exudes a quiet space. Coming here, visitors can pray in a peaceful setting, you will feel your soul lighter than ever.

The incense offering area at Ba Vang Pagoda is built very specially. There are professional sculptors who create all the Buddha statues, bringing authenticity to the spiritual world.

The Buddhist prayer tour at Ba Vang Pagoda brings visitors many spiritual values, you can learn more about the unique features of Vietnamese Buddhism and participate in many other spiritual activities. Buddhists and monks in the pagoda will pray with you.

Thien Mu Pagoda

One of the most ancient and sacred pagodas in Hue. The pagoda is located majestically on Ha Khe hill, about 5 km from the center of Hue city. This is a spiritual tourist destination and famous for short pilgrimage tours of tourists traveling to Vietnam.

Thien Mu Pagoda was built in the traditional architectural style of Vietnam. There are many unique architectural works such as Phuoc Duyen Tower, Pho Minh Tower, Quan Am Statue, Thien Mu Lake, … All create a unique and harmonious architectural space.

Thien Mu Pagoda has high cultural and religious value, considered a sacred pagoda of Central Vietnam. The pagoda has many valuable cultural heritages such as Buddha statues and beautiful sculptures.

Every year, on the 15th day of the third lunar month, Thien Mu Pagoda holds a special festival that attracts many participants. This is an opportunity for you to learn more about the culture and beliefs at Thien Mu Pagoda in Hue.

It can be said that a pilgrimage to pray at Thien Mu Pagoda will leave visitors with a wonderful impression. Buddhist rituals and prayers will help you have a peaceful and relaxed soul.

Thien Hau Pagoda

If you are looking for a pilgrimage tour, Thien Hau Pagoda is the destination for you. The pagoda is a spiritual tourist destination for many Buddhists and visitors from all over the world to pray.

It can be said that Thien Hau Pagoda (also known as Ba Temple) is one of the famous pagodas in Vietnam. The pagoda was built in the traditional Chinese architectural style, combined with Western architectural elements. The pagoda has many unique architectural works, such as arched bridges, high towers and beautiful artifacts.

Thien Hau Pagoda has high religious and cultural value, and is a place where Buddhists and visitors come to burn incense and pray. This place has many valuable cultural heritages, imbued with the culture of both China and Vietnam.

The pagoda has a special festival, which is the Ba Dam Festival (also known as the Source Festival), which takes place annually on the 23rd day of the first lunar month.

The Ba Dam Festival is a traditional Chinese festival held to pray for a bountiful harvest. This festival helps people avoid natural disasters and brings good luck to their families and communities. On this day, Chinese families in Vietnam will go to Ba Thien Hau Temple to burn incense and pray to Ba Dam.

During the Ba Dam Festival, Ba Thien Hau Temple takes place in a solemn and brilliant atmosphere and has many Buddhist activities. If you plan to travel to Vietnam, visit Ba Thien Hau Temple during the festival to immerse yourself in the solemn atmosphere of the festival. It can be said that this is the most memorable pilgrimage for visitors.

Tam Chuc Pagoda

If you are looking for a pilgrimage destination, Tam Chuc Pagoda is the destination for you, especially in early spring. The pagoda covers an area of ​​up to 5,100 hectares, and includes many towers and beautiful architectural works.

Tam Chuc Pagoda is built in the traditional Vietnamese architectural style, combined with Western and Chinese architectural elements, creating a unique and impressive architectural space.

Tam Chuc is considered an important spiritual site in Vietnam, with many works and relics of spiritual and historical value. The pagoda attracts many tourists and people to visit and pray for peace and health.

In addition to praying with Buddhists, visitors also participate in a special hooijd ceremony at the pagoda that takes place annually on the 15th day of the 4th lunar month.

Tam Chuc Festival is one of the largest religious festivals in Vietnam. The festival attracts thousands of Buddhists and tourists to participate. This festival lasts for three days, starting from the 14th to the 16th of the fourth lunar month, with many unique religious and cultural activities.

During the Tam Chuc festival, Buddhists come to the temple to pray and make offerings, wishing for a new year of peace, luck and prosperity. Especially on the festival day, Tam Chuc pagoda is brilliantly decorated with many diverse religious activities.

The temple is one of the spiritual tours for Buddhists, people and tourists in Vietnam.

Truc Lam Zen Monastery

The temple is located in Da Lat city, Lam Dong province, Vietnam. This is the largest Zen Buddhist monastery in Vietnam and a famous tourist destination in Da Lat.

Truc Lam Zen Monastery is designed in the traditional Vietnamese architectural style, combining harmony and diversity. Surrounding the temple are mountains, waterfalls and blue lakes.

Truc Lam Zen Monastery is a tourist destination and a place for spiritual practice and academic study of Zen Buddhist monks. The Zen Monastery is also open to visitors to visit and participate in courses on meditation, living methods and Buddhist philosophy.

This is a place to train and nurture Zen Buddhist monks to help them have the best training and academic study. All of this is to spread Buddhist teachings and help the community.

In addition, when visiting the temple, visitors can also participate in the prayers and meditation of Buddhists, and you will find your soul more peaceful, because Buddhist teachings contain many profound spiritual values.

This pilgrimage will give you many opportunities to participate in exchanges with Vietnamese Buddhism, especially meditation.

In addition to the spiritual tourism destinations that Vietlook Travel has just shared above, you can take note of the experience when traveling spiritually in Vietnam.

When going to a temple in Vietnam, praying is something you need to pay attention to. To have the best experience and be suitable for the religious culture in Vietnam, you need to pay attention to the following:

Dress: You should wear formal and respectful clothes when going to the temple. Avoid wearing short skirts, shorts or revealing clothes.

Shoes: When going to the temple, you should leave your shoes outside when entering the temple. The place of worship in the temple is usually very solemn. You can bring a pair of socks to keep your feet warm.

In the temple grounds, you must always stay calm and avoid making noise or being too disorderly. You should also avoid smoking, eating or bringing food into the temple grounds.

Offerings: If you want to make offerings or burn incense, you should ask the people in the temple or local people to know how to do it properly.

Respecting religious beliefs: You should respect the cultural beliefs of local people in each region and the temple.

Bringing equipment: If you want to take photos or film, ask the temple keeper or local people for advice to avoid violating regulations.

Visiting: When visiting the temple, you should follow the temple’s rules, do not tear, cut or damage objects in the temple grounds.

In addition, you should ask local people or temple keeper for more information about notes when visiting the temple, to avoid violating the religious regulations and cultural ethics of Vietnamese people.

People can pray to Buddhism in many different places depending on the beliefs and religions in each locality with places of prayer including

Temples or temples: These are places to perform religious rituals, pray, Temples are often solemnly decorated with statues of Buddha and masters, altars, oil lamps, incense, candles, rosaries, … for praying and offering.

Parks, gardens and temples: These are natural, peaceful and beautiful places that can bring a sense of peace and closeness to nature. Many people go to these places to seek tranquility and pray for a more relaxed soul.

At home: Some people can pray and make offerings at home, on the altar, in the altar or Buddha statue to worship to bring a sense of peace in their own home.

Meditation center: A place where people can learn and practice meditation, an important meditation method in Buddhism. People can participate in classes, seminars, full moon retreats and events related to Buddhism and meditation.

These are the prayers that should be consulted before traveling on a sacred pilgrimage, however each locality will have different religious customs.

To pray at a Buddhist monastery, you can follow these steps:

Understand the monastery: Before praying at a Buddhist monastery, it is important to learn information about the monastery such as the schedule of activities, rituals, regulations, … of the monastery.

Prepare appropriate clothing: When visiting a monastery, you should wear appropriate, respectful, modest and simple clothing, dress politely.

Worship at the temple: When entering the temple, you must be respectful and avoid causing disorder or noise. You can bow, clasp your hands, offer incense or do anything appropriate according to the temple’s regulations.

Participate in activities: If there are any activities at the monastery, you can participate to connect with the Buddhist community and improve your mental health.

Participate in Buddha worship: If there is a Buddha worship ceremony taking place at the monastery, you can pray and honor the Buddha.

Behavior: Do not disturb or offend the beliefs of others.

Learn Buddhist teachings: If you have the opportunity, you can learn more about Buddhist teachings to gain a deeper understanding of the religion and the meaning of prayer.

These are some general steps for praying at a Buddhist monastery. However, specific practices may vary depending on the rules and traditions of each monastery and locality.

How to choose a pilgrimage site

Choose a peaceful temple, and pray for health, success, happiness or any positive outcome you desire. Show respect and gratitude to the Buddha by bowing, reciting a prayer or visualizing an image of the Buddha.

End your prayer with sincere gratitude, respect and humility. You can donate a small amount of money to a Buddhist organization or charity to show your appreciation and compassion.

Remember that the most important aspect of Buddhist prayer is not the words you say but what you feel deep in your heart.

A Buddhist prayer pilgrimage can bring many spiritual and material values ​​to an individual. If you are a Buddhist and interested in learning about Buddhism in different countries, then Vietnam is a great place for you to pray.
